note: First content is measured by server parsing; browser paint is measured separately in the UI. Setup time is outside these warmed request measurements.

results.name: pricing
results.prompt: Create a pricing section with Starter $12, Pro $29, and Team $79 monthly plans, three features each, and choose-plan buttons. Highlight Pro.
results.program:
root = Col([header, plans], 6)
header = Col([Title("Simple, transparent pricing", "xl"), Text("Choose the plan that fits your needs. Cancel anytime.", "sm", "muted")], 2)
plans = Grid([starterCard, proCard, teamCard], 3, 200, 4)
starterCard = Card([starterHeader, starterPrice, starterList, starterBtn], "outline", 6, 4)
starterHeader = Col([Title("Starter", "md"), Caption("For individuals and small tests")], 1)
starterPrice = Row([Title("$12", "2xl"), Caption("/month")], 1, "end")
starterList = List(["Up to 3 projects", "Basic analytics", "Community support"], "bullet")
starterBtn = Button("Choose Starter", @ToAssistant("Selected Starter plan"), "outline", null, "md", null, false, true)
proCard = Card([proHeader, proPrice, proList, proBtn], "soft", 6, 4)
proHeader = Row([Col([Title("Pro", "md"), Caption("For growing creators")], 1), Spacer(), Badge("Popular", "purple")], 2, "start", "between")
proPrice = Row([Title("$29", "2xl"), Caption("/month")], 1, "end")
proList = List(["Unlimited projects", "Advanced analytics", "Priority email support"], "bullet")
proBtn = Button("Choose Pro", @ToAssistant("Selected Pro plan"), "solid", "primary", "md", null, false, true)
teamCard = Card([teamHeader, teamPrice, teamList, teamBtn], "outline", 6, 4)
teamHeader = Col([Title("Team", "md"), Caption("For collaborative organizations")], 1)
teamPrice = Row([Title("$79", "2xl"), Caption("/month")], 1, "end")
teamList = List(["Unlimited team members", "Dedicated workspaces", "24/7 phone support"], "bullet")
teamBtn = Button("Choose Team", @ToAssistant("Selected Team plan"), "outline", null, "md", null, false, true)

results.name: stats
results.prompt: Create three stats cards: monthly revenue $48,200 up 12%, active customers 2,840 up 8%, and churn 1.8% down 0.3 points. Add trend badges.
results.program:
root = Col([heading, statsGrid], 5)
heading = Col([Title("Key Performance Metrics", "xl"), Text("Performance summary for the current month compared to last month.", "sm", "muted")], 1)
statsGrid = Grid([revenueCard, customersCard, churnCard], 3, 180, 4)
revenueCard = Card([revenueTop, revenueValue], "outline", 6, 3)
revenueTop = Row([Caption("Monthly revenue"), Spacer(), Badge("+12%", "success")], 2, "center", "between")
revenueValue = Title("$48,200", "2xl")
customersCard = Card([customersTop, customersValue], "outline", 6, 3)
customersTop = Row([Caption("Active customers"), Spacer(), Badge("+8%", "success")], 2, "center", "between")
customersValue = Title("2,840", "2xl")
churnCard = Card([churnTop, churnValue], "outline", 6, 3)
churnTop = Row([Caption("Churn rate"), Spacer(), Badge("-0.3 pts", "success")], 2, "center", "between")
churnValue = Title("1.8%", "2xl")

results.name: form
results.prompt: Create a compact contact form with name, email, a project type selector, message, and Send enquiry button.
results.program:
root = Col([heading, formCard], 5)
heading = Col([Title("Get in touch", "xl"), Text("Tell us about your project and we will respond within 24 hours.", "sm", "muted")], 1)
formCard = Card([contactForm], "outline", 6, 4)
contactForm = Form([nameInput, emailInput, projectSelect, messageArea, submitBtn])
$name = ""
nameInput = Input($name, "Your name", "text", "Alex Morgan")
$email = ""
emailInput = Input($email, "Email address", "text", "alex@example.com")
$projectType = "Web Design"
projectSelect = Select($projectType, ["Web Design", "Mobile App", "Branding", "Consulting"], "Project type", "Select a service")
$message = ""
messageArea = TextArea($message, "Project details", "Share your goals, timeline, and budget...", 4)
submitBtn = Button("Send enquiry", @ToAssistant("Send enquiry"), "solid", "primary", "md", null, false, true)

results.name: chart
results.prompt: Create a compact revenue widget with total revenue, a growth badge, and a line chart for the last six months. Use sample data.
results.program:
root = Col([heading, revenueCard], 5)
heading = Title("Revenue overview", "xl")
revenueCard = Card([cardHeader, totalAmount, chart], "outline", 6, 4)
cardHeader = Row([Caption("Last six months"), Spacer(), Badge("+14.2% vs prev period", "success")], 3, "center", "between")
totalAmount = Title("$184,500", "2xl")
chart = Chart("line", [{month: "May", revenue: 24500}, {month: "Jun", revenue: 27200}, {month: "Jul", revenue: 29800}, {month: "Aug", revenue: 32400}, {month: "Sep", revenue: 34100}, {month: "Oct", revenue: 36500}], "month", ["revenue"], "currency", "USD", false, 200)

results.name: table
results.prompt: Create a recent orders widget with a heading and a table of four sample orders with customer, product, amount, and payment status.
results.program:
root = Col([heading, tableCard], 5)
heading = Col([Title("Recent orders", "xl"), Text("Overview of customer purchases from the past 24 hours.", "sm", "muted")], 1)
tableCard = Card([ordersTable], "outline", 5, 3)
ordersTable = Table(["Customer", "Product", "Amount", "Status"], [orderRow1, orderRow2, orderRow3, orderRow4])
orderRow1 = ["Sophia Patel", "Pro Annual Subscription", "$290.00", Badge("Paid", "success")]
orderRow2 = ["Marcus Vance", "Design System UI Kit", "$79.00", Badge("Paid", "success")]
orderRow3 = ["Elena Rostova", "Cloud Hosting Add-on", "$35.00", Badge("Pending", "warning")]
orderRow4 = ["David Kim", "Custom Domain Transfer", "$15.00", Badge("Refunded", "neutral")]
